Good to know

Before you order.

Call the shop at (601) 736-0663.

Contact Relevant↗
How many shirts do I need to order?

Tell us your estimated quantity and design. We’ll confirm the production method, options, and any minimum for that specific job.

Can you create a design from my idea?

Yes. Send your logo, sketches, or references. We can include design work in the quote and provide a proof for approval.

What information helps you quote shirts?

Garment style and color, sizes and approximate quantities, print locations, number of ink colors, artwork, and the date you need the order.

What can we
make for you?

Tell us what you need, how many, and when you need it. We’ll help you work out the details.
